## Publication

**Authors:** Sophal Chan, Kwankamon Dittakan *(corresponding)*  
**Venue:** RTIP2R 2018, CCIS vol. 1036, pp. 209–225, Springer Singapore, 2019  
**DOI:** [10.1007/978-981-13-9184-2_19](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-981-13-9184-2_19)

## Background of the Study

Clinical OA is graded 0–4 on X-rays; automating **stage classification** supports radiologist workflow and population screening.

## Motivation of the Study

Determine which knee ROI and texture pipeline best predicts **OA severity grade** using correlation-based feature selection.

## Key Result

**Medial Tibia (MT) ROI → AUC = 0.871** on 130-image dataset.
